defaults.method: A body slid over 90 blocks of a custom block that sets no friction: it lost friction * 0.91 of its speed per tick, as it does on the vanilla floors listed under friction.vanilla. The conversion of the component is confirmed (friction.components).

Block light from glowstone next to a custom block that sets no light_dampening, read behind it and inside it: less light gets into it than into light_dampening 14 (0 against 1) and none gets through, as with stone; BDS accepts at most 15.

The light next to a custom block that sets no light_emission is 0, as next to stone; next to light_emission 15 it is 14. An emission of 1 would light nothing next to it either, so 0 is the value that lights nothing.

Destroyed beside explosions (power 4) at distance 7: a custom block that sets no resistance 12/48, the same as explosion_resistance 0 and more often than the others (Fisher's exact test, against each: dirt 0/48 p<0.001; sand 0/48 p<0.001; explosion_resistance_0 14/48 p=0.819; explosion_resistance_3 0/48 p<0.001). The unit is the component's.

Bodies pushed at a custom block that sets no collision_box from the four sides stopped at x 0 to 1 and z 0 to 1 exactly as at stone (bodies 0.5 tall level with its bottom half), and a body dropped onto it landed on its top, 1 above its bottom, as on stone (a block with collision_box false let it fall through).

Fire on top of 12 custom blocks that set no flammable component, 400 ticks with fire ticking: all 12 were still there, as with stone; with minecraft:flammable true (and oak planks) none was. It does not burn away.

Fire on top of 12 custom blocks that set no flammable component, 400 ticks with fire ticking: all 12 were still there, as with stone; with minecraft:flammable true (and oak planks) none was. A block that cannot burn away is not flammable, so it has no odds of catching fire; the test does not read that value separately.

friction.method: Entity speed loss per tick (median over the slide) divided by 0.91, 3 decimals; the floor of every lane is a block of one kind
friction.engine_friction_is: 1 - the value of minecraft:friction (every probed value, within 0.002)
